description: Index of every model workers/ml-runtime may load, and the policy governing what may be loaded. Claude owns the contents; Codex owns the loader. A model not listed here cannot be loaded.

load_policy.preprocessing_unpinned_note: Issue #33. A config whose letterbox pad_value is null has declared that the value of the padded band is not established upstream. Release refuses it (CONFIG_UNPINNED); development permits it, because development is where the missing measurement gets taken and a gate that forbids running the model makes taking it impossible.

photo_analysis.note: The selected stack. SCRFD + ArcFace are the most accurate available and are what the product is built on for internal use. Their weights are non-commercial, so this pipeline is development-only by construction -- release mode refuses it rather than someone remembering not to ship it. laion-aesthetic-v2 is removed until its head is retrained on SigLIP 2 features; a pipeline must be end-to-end runnable, and a known-broken step makes it a plan rather than a pipeline.

photo_analysis_release.note: The licence-clean swap path. Detection only -- there is still no commercially-usable recognition model, which is the real open problem behind issue #3. Kept working so the swap is mechanical when it is needed. laion-aesthetic-v2 is removed until its head is retrained on SigLIP 2 features; a pipeline must be end-to-end runnable, and a known-broken step makes it a plan rather than a pipeline. NO SAFETY GATE YET: nsfw-siglip-head is registered but unselected, so this pipeline cannot filter sensitive content. That is a hard release blocker in its own right -- shipping automated albums and shared reels with no sensitive-content gate is a user-visible harm, not a quality gap -- and it is recorded here rather than in somebody's memory.

classical_quality.description: The cheap first pass: Laplacian variance for sharpness, histogram entropy discounted by clipping for exposure, Immerkaer's estimator for noise, luma standard deviation for contrast, plus the black-frame and lens-obstruction flags. No weights, no host, no network, no GPU. It runs first in photo_analysis because it is nearly free and because it is what makes MediaRecord's required quality fields exist at all -- treating it as a no-op would produce records that look analysed and carry no measurements, which is worse than leaving the step missing.

license.note: Written in this repository. The two named algorithms are published methods, not licensed artifacts: the discrete 4-neighbour Laplacian is textbook, and Immerkaer's fast noise estimator (Computer Vision and Image Understanding, 1996) is described in a paper rather than distributed as code. No third-party implementation was copied, which is the thing worth recording -- 'it is only arithmetic' is exactly the reasoning that lets a GPL implementation in unnoticed.
